why: These bytes are this repository's own output, not somebody else's work, and the record says
so because `tools/asset_provenance.py` will not let a file it cannot read sit in the tree
unaccounted for. A generated entry carries the command and no digest: the bytes are already
second copy of them here would only be a second place to forget to update.
What the fixture is for is ADR 0053: the loader is read against bytes this generator wrote
rather than against its author's idea of the format. It is a format fixture and not a
measurement — 48x36 frames are a specimen, and the world accuracy is measured in is
